svg.title: lect13d p1 parent reference
svg.desc: Four parent chromosomes numbered 1,3,4,2 in original row order, beside the original gamete reference image. Source ODP39.

svg.title: Ruby translocation chromosome set
svg.desc: Four source-specific unreplicated chromosome rods with integrated round centromeres. Gray-blue and blue segments distinguish the two translocated chromosomes; the normal Y is red.

svg.title: Reciprocal-translocation gamete products
svg.desc: Three columns of four gametes, each with two unreplicated chromosomes. Source red and blue ancestry segments and the distinct final two normal chromosome orders are preserved.

g.text: All gametes from adjacent-1 and adjacent-2
